note: Hand-authored, partial. `quote` is verbatim from https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6749 with line wrapping removed and nothing else changed. The first row is the authorization-code reuse checkbox of the certification runbook's Step 7 (#627); the rest of RFC 6749 is still to be written, so the spec stays unsealed and citations that match no row are reported as orphans rather than failing the build.

requirements.quote: If an authorization code is used more than once, the authorization server MUST deny the request and SHOULD revoke (when possible) all tokens previously issued based on that authorization code.
requirements.applies: POST /oauth/token, authorization_code grant. The MUST half: a spent code answers `invalid_grant`. The SHOULD half: a replay that is otherwise a valid request revokes the refresh-token family the first redemption started and the access tokens issued from the code or in that family (see the oauth-2_1 rows for the conditions and for when an access token cannot be revoked).
requirements.evidenceMatch: revokes the refresh family|family revoked|revokes the access token
